channel.title: Export Controls Watch
channel.description: US and EU export-control changes, machine-detected, system-drafted and cited to primary sources. Not legal advice.

item.title: BIS renews one-year Temporary Denial Order against UTair Aviation JSC for continued EAR violations
item.description: BIS renewed, for a period of one year, the Temporary Denial Order (TDO) originally issued April 7, 2022 and previously renewed on October 3, 2022, March 29, 2023, September 23, 2023, September 20, 2024, and September 16, 2025 against UTair Aviation JSC, based on evidence that UTair continued to operate aircraft classified under ECCN 9A991.b on flights into, out of, and within Russia without required BIS authorization, in violation of the Regulations and the prior TDO [FR Doc. 2026-19019, Section II.B]. The Assistant Secretary found the violations significant and deliberate and part of a pattern of repeated, ongoing and/or continuous apparent violations, warranting renewal for the maximum one-year period under 15 CFR 766.24(d) [FR Doc. 2026-19019, Section III].

item.title: State Dept adds 14 individuals/entities to ITAR Debarred List via 91 FR 46821
item.description: The State Department's Directorate of Defense Trade Controls added fourteen parties to the ITAR Debarred List in a single batch [CSL:ITAR Debarred (DTC) - State Department:snap-a4f299169a95c28b].

item.title: BIS removes one Turkey-based entity from the Entity List
item.description: BIS amended the EAR by removing Atempo Proje Taahhüt Ses ve Görüntü Sistemleri Anonim Şirketi İstanbul Şubesi, Bülent Ecevit Bulvarı, in Turkey from the Entity List under supplement no. 4 to part 744, based on information received pursuant to Sec. 744.16(e) and ERC review under supplement no. 5 to part 744 [FR Doc. 2026-17230, Removal From the Entity List].

item.title: BIS removes two Hong Kong addresses from Arrow Electronics (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. Entity List entry (China)
item.description: BIS revised the Entity List entry for Arrow Electronics (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. under the destination of China by removing two addresses — 2/F and 3/F, Green 18, Phase 2, Hong Kong Science Park, Hong Kong; and Units 11001-11008E & 11001-11012W, 11th Floor, ATL Logistics Centre B, No. 8 Container Port Road South, Kwai Chung, Hong Kong — following ERC review under Sec. 744.16 of the EAR [FR Doc. 2026-17231, Removals From the Entity List]. This follows the November 2025 removal of Arrow China Electronics Trading Co., Ltd. and six aliases for Arrow Electronics (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. [FR Doc. 2026-17231, Background].

item.title: BIS extends ECCN 3A090.a approved IC designer application deadline from April 13, 2026 to December 31, 2026
item.description: BIS has amended Note 1 to ECCN 3A090.a in paragraphs a.(2) and (3) by removing the date 'April 13, 2026' wherever it occurs and replacing it with 'December 31, 2026' [FR Doc. 2026-06851, Supplement No. 1 to Part 774, ECCN 3A090 amendment]. The triggering date for authorized IC designer status and the submission deadline for applications to become an approved IC designer are both extended by approximately eight months [FR Doc. 2026-06851, SUMMARY]. Applicants who submit by December 31, 2026 may be considered authorized IC designers for 180 days after that date [FR Doc. 2026-06851, DATES]. BIS estimates the extension will result in approximately 20 additional approved IC designers and an increase of 385 burden hours under OMB Control Number 0694-0137 [FR Doc. 2026-06851, Rulemaking Requirements §2]. BIS also estimates approximately 75 additional advisory opinions and 38 additional burden hours under OMB Control Number 0694-0088 [FR Doc. 2026-06851, Rulemaking Requirements §2].

item.title: Corrigendum deletes the sub-193 nm light-source criterion from Annex I entry 3B501.f.1.a
item.description: The corrigendum of 9 February 2026 to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/2003 replaces the text of entry 3B501.f.1.a, 'A light source wavelength shorter than 193 nm; or', with 'Not used;' [OJ L 2026/90092, entry 3B501.f.1.a]. 'Not used' is the Annex I placeholder for a deleted provision: the sub-193 nm light-source criterion no longer exists as a route into entry 3B501.f.1, whose remaining sub-points are unchanged [OJ L 2026/90092, entry 3B501.f.1.a].
